Confidence intervals for the provider effects of a logistic fixed-effect fit

Source: R/confint_logistic_fe.R
confint.logistic_fe.Rd

Intervals for \(\gamma_i\) obtained by inverting a test: the exact Poisson-binomial test, the score test with \(\hat\beta\) held fixed, or a Wald test with the naive or patient-clustered standard error. Intervals for standardized measures are produced by standardize(), which maps these limits through the standardization.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'logistic_fe'
confint(
  object,
  parm = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  type = c("exact", "score", "wald", "robust_wald"),
  wald_variance = c("case_mix", "full"),
  alternative = c("two.sided", "greater", "less"),
  ...
)

Arguments

object

a model fitted by fit_logistic_fe().

parm

optional subset of provider identifiers.

level

confidence level. Default 0.95.

type

"exact" (default), "score", "wald" or "robust_wald".

wald_variance

for type = "wald": "case_mix" (default) or "full", see gamma_variance().

alternative

"two.sided" (default), "greater" (lower limit only) or "less" (upper limit only).

...

unused.

Value

A data frame with provider, estimate, lower, upper.

Details

Providers with no events have no finite lower limit and providers with all events no finite upper limit; their finite limit is one-sided at level 1 - level. The exact inversion works on the individual Bernoulli trials and is slow for providers with very many trials.

Examples

d <- sim_kecc(n_providers = 10, seed = 1)
pd <- pp_data(d, y = "y", x = c("x1", "x2", "x3"), provider = "provider",
              patient = "patient", message = FALSE)
fit <- fit_logistic_fe(pd)
confint(fit, type = "score")
#>    provider   estimate      lower       upper
#> 1      P001 -0.5016517 -1.0249137  0.02184901
#> 2      P002 -0.9618830 -1.2923892 -0.63132908
#> 3      P003 -0.1930757 -0.7812240  0.39521893
#> 4      P004 -1.4712752 -1.8799614 -1.06247731
#> 5      P005 -0.9757544 -1.3901379 -0.56124741
#> 6      P006 -0.6629494 -0.9685020 -0.35736727
#> 7      P007 -0.4959592 -0.9180087 -0.07386339
#> 8      P008 -2.0741234 -2.6519146 -1.49608335
#> 9      P009 -0.6788108 -1.0268220 -0.33076124
#> 10     P010 -0.6808666 -1.0730397 -0.28860917
